name: Beef-tendon herbal stew
summary: Beef tendon stewed in its own pot with ginseng and Chinese herbs at Tài Ký, 39 Bùi Thị Xuân.
origin: Beef tendon among the tiềm pots at Tài Ký, stewed with ginseng and Chinese herbs.
howToEat: Choose from the row of tiềm pots at Tài Ký: chicken, pigeon, beef tendon, pork tendon, pork brain, or ngọc hành.
